content.title: Travel to Europe your way | Multi-Country Rail Tours
content.text: If you enjoy our Multi-Country Rail Tour, you will be able to take advantage of an excellent developed railway network in Europe, High-speed Rail like the “Eurostar” in between London, Paris, and Brussels, the “ICE” within Germany, the “TGV” within France and the “RailJet” within Austria. Not to mention the Speed Rail “InterCity” and “EuroCity” trains, running connecting all major cities in Europe. Trains take you under the sea (through the Channel Tunnel) and on the Top of Europe, the highest railway station located in the Swiss Alp Mountains. Europe offers cultural diversity: 47 countries in a comparatively small area. Each European country has a rich history and you will find a wide cultural variety, different traditions and a great variety of culinary delights.Garmisch-Partenkirchen Main StationBy High-Speed Rail you travel from London to Paris in less than 2.5 hours, from Munich to Salzburg in less than 1.5 hours and from Venice to Rome in less than 4 hours. The European Railways network with the High-Speed trains with top speeds of up to 220 mph allow you to visit multiple countries during a Holiday in Europe without wasting much of your vacation time traveling. Please find a wide variety of our Central Europe Holiday Packages by Rail on an overview page by clicking the picture below.Rail Jet Train ©Thomas H. GiesickMost tours start and end right from International Airports. At Frankfurt International Airport for example, the largest airport in continental Europe, you will find two different Rail Stations: the Regional Rail Station (located below baggage claim in Terminal 1) and the Long Distance Rail Station (called “AiRail”) which is connected to Terminal 1. You do not need an airport transfer, your railway holiday starts right at the airport terminal: in about an hour you are in front of the Cathedral in Cologne for example, in less than two hours in Wurzburg, gateway to the Romantic Road!Frankfurt Airport Long Distance Rail Station – AiRail ©Thomas H. GiesickWe designed attractive Europe Vacation Packages, if you are looking for a Multi Country Rail Tour you have the choice – from the 5 Day Paris to Vienna 1st-Class Rail Tour (5R01) (covering France, Germany and Austria) to the 23 Days Europe Rail Circle Tour (23R01) . The Vacation Package which starts and ends at London Heathrow Airport covers eight European Countries and takes you to the Cities of London, Paris, Berlin, Munich, Cologne, Vienna, Salzburg, Prague, Budapest, Bratislava, Brussels, Bruges.Linderhof Palace Ettal © Softeis and Neuschwanstein Castle Oberammergau ©Cezary PiwowarskAmong the most popular of our Multi Country Rail Tour Packages are the 9 Day Germany and Austria Rail Circle Tour (9R02) which covers many Highlights of Southern Germany (Bavaria and Heidelberg) and Austria, the 8 Day Vienna, Prague, Berlin Rail Tour (8R01), which takes you to the capital cities of Austria, Czech Republic and Germany, the 11 Day Frankfurt to Rome Rail Tour (11R01) (which covers the Romantic Road, Munich, the Royal Castles, the Alp Mountains, Venice and Rome) and the 10 Day Germany & Switzerland Rail Circle Tour (10R03) (which covers the South of Germany, the Royal Castles and the Swiss Mountains).
